title: Amazon API Gateway integration with AWS WAF
description: Create an Amazon API Gateway integration with AWS WAF

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern in SAM provides a means to generate a WebACL and associate it with an existing REST or Websocket API (HTTP APIs are not currently supported).

testing.headline: Testing
text: Invoke the API with the appropriate stage. To view the WebACL rules, visit the Management Console and navigate to the WAF & Shield service page.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus".
